title: AI4Finance-Foundation/FinGPT provides open financial-model building blocks
friendlyTitle: FinGPT offers open AI tools for financial research
summary: FinGPT is an MIT-licensed open-source project for financial language models, with more than 21,000 GitHub stars at publication. It includes data pipelines, sentiment models, benchmarks and a forecaster workflow, with models and datasets also available through Hugging Face.
friendlySummary: FinGPT includes open models, data tools and tests for working with financial text. It also provides examples for sentiment analysis and market forecasting research.
whyItMatters: Researchers and developers can use FinGPT to study financial sentiment, lightweight fine-tuning and domain-specific evaluation without starting from a closed financial model. Its outputs are research aids, not financial advice; market coverage, old dependencies, data quality and predictive claims all need independent review before real decisions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help researchers build and compare financial AI systems. Do not treat its predictions as investment advice, and check the data and software carefully before use.
